name: Kenneth Ho
headline: UX Engineer
summary: UX Engineer with over a decade of frontend experience, from agency campaigns and interactive installations to enterprise B2B platforms.
I specialise in polished UI animation, high-fidelity microinteractions and 3D/WebGL on the web, and I lead frontend delivery across design, API and security teams.

bullets: Built a multi-tenant, white-labelled B2B insurance platform with Next.js and GraphQL that lets each insurer apply its own theme and deploy its own branded experience.
Set up UI component standards and workflows so that new, complex commercial insurance products can be integrated quickly each year.
Engineered a dynamic form engine on React JSON Schema Form (RJSF) that handles variable policy definitions across insurers and brokers.
Integrated JSONata to map differing insurance data schemas, transforming API and GraphQL payloads across policy versions.
Lead frontend delivery across Design, API and Security teams, covering performance, design accuracy and enterprise compliance.
Built frontend prototypes and 3D web interfaces to explore future concepts for Dell's digital ecosystem.
Engineered immersive, highly optimised 3D interfaces with Three.js, WebGL, Canvas and WebXR.
Lead frontend engineer for an interactive installation that tracked users by connecting UI pipelines to LIDAR, Kinect, ZED 2, OpenCV and machine-learning models.
Developed 2D interfaces and custom GLSL shaders in Unity for Dell's concept showcase at CES 2022.
Built the frontend foundation for SK-II's global design system and digital rebrand ahead of the Tokyo Olympic Games.
Led frontend execution for Bristol Myers Squibb, engineering microinteractions, dynamic visuals and fluid animations.
Directed development sprints with an external vendor team (Mindtree), using high-fidelity React and Vue prototypes to preserve design intent.
Engineered web applications and PWAs for Google's enterprise B2B sites.
Built the "Make Your Pringles" campaign PWA for Korea, solving API compatibility and camera-access issues in restricted in-app browsers (KakaoTalk, LINE, Samsung Internet).
Developed custom WebGL shaders and optimised Canvas and SVG animations for international brand campaigns.
Partnered with clients including Unilever to rapidly prototype emerging web features, AR filters and web-based brand assets.
Managed frontend delivery for Samsung APAC flagship launches, building the launch sites and campaign assets for the Galaxy Note8, S9 and Note9.
Introduced modern frontend frameworks to the creative division, narrowing the gap between design and production.
Automated build pipelines with Gulp, cutting delivery times for rich media and EDMs.
Developed localised, component-driven experiences in Adobe Experience Manager for 100Plus and MSD Keytruda.
Developed an interaction-heavy web application for modelling and mapping biological gene sequences.
Co-developed a drag-and-drop email builder that serialises its output for marketing automation platforms.
Engineered a generative physical-digital installation that used live weather and social media data to render visuals and ambient audio.
Took part in agile scrums, pair programming and UX/UI design sprints to find usability issues and improve layouts.

earlier.summary: Telenor Group's global WordPress sites, Zespri campaign SPAs ("Sweeter Than You Think") and localised Tiger Beer brand sites.
Multi-touch Adobe AIR installations for the Monetary Authority of Singapore Gallery that explain CPI, inflation and fiscal policy.
Animated web apps and Unity, Kinect and Leap Motion installations for LG, Lipton, Bata and Lee Hwa.
